question: Ustaad Amjad Ali Khan is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustaad Amjad Ali Khan** is associated with the **musical instrument Sarod.**
 
• The** Sarod** is a** stringed musical instrument** that is used mainly in** Indian classical music.**
 
• It is made of wood and has a **fretless fingerboard**, which means that the player can slide their fingers along the strings to produce **different notes.**
 
• The Sarod is played with a plectrum made of **coconut shell or ivory**, and the strings are usually made of **metal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saarangi** is a **bowed string instrument.**
 
• **Sitar** is a **plucked string instrument.**
 
• **Veena** is a **stringed instrument** used mainly in **South Indian classical music.**
